1. Debug text files are not provided for stage 5. However, you can produce them yourself by running
output-1.bin through your stage 2 program
.
2. In stage 5, the fields are in a different order within each record and the records are in a different order in the output file because the output file is sorted. 
These differences make stage 5 considerably more difficult than stage 4.



# RECORDS
> Records of your data files contain the following fields in the following sequence.
Field purpose must be an integer in eight bytes 
Field power must be a floating point number in eight bytes 
Field cracker must be an unsigned integer in four bytes 
Field grandfather must be an integer in two bytes 
Field guitar must be a Boolean in one byte 
Field appliance must be a Boolean in one byte 
Field channel must be a Boolean in one byte 
Field manager must be a Boolean in two bytes 
Field cent must be a fixed-length string holding at most 11 characters (including terminating nulls) 
Field drain must be a Boolean in one byte 
Field spiders must be a character in one byte 
Field clover must be a floating point number in four bytes 
Field lamp must be an unsigned integer in one byte 
Field food must be a floating point number in four bytes 
Field help must be a floating point number in four bytes 
Field badge must be a Boolean in two bytes 
Field flowers must be a character in one byte 

`xxd -b -c 1 input-1.bin` good command

# PATTERNS
- Input files sizes are multiples of 53 
(byte 19 holds a bit-packed flag for guitar/channel/manager/appliance)

- Output files sizes are multiples of 56 (struct size)
bytes 3, 5, 21, and 31 all contain ZERO (00000000)


## INPUT FILE
### Unused Bytes
- offsets 3, 5, 21, and 31

> example from input-4.bin
> 00000000 11011001 01101110 *00000000* 00001111 *00000000*
here can see bytes at index 3 and 5 are zero!




## OUTPUT FILE
- sizeof(file) divided by 56 (sizeof struct(might be 53)? OR output-1.bin ) 
-> this contains amount of leading empty or full bytes at start of file

- array is alphabetical ordered by cent
